$comment: Advisories accepted with a documented reason and an expiry date. audit-gate.mjs fails CI on any advisory at or above the threshold that is NOT listed here, and also fails on entries past their expiry so this file cannot rot silently.

allow.reason: Transitive via @solana/spl-token -> @solana/buffer-layout-utils. Upstream has no patched release; npm's only proposed fix is a downgrade to @solana/spl-token@0.1.8 (semver-major, pre-token-2022) which would break every token tool in this server.
Transitive via @solana/web3.js v1 -> jayson. Not reachable from this server: we never parse untrusted streamed JSON-RPC responses through jayson's stream path.
Transitive via @coral-xyz/anchor, used only to read local Anchor.toml at build time. No patched version published; not exposed to remote input.
Same dependency path and reachability as GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf.
Transitive via @solana/web3.js v1. Affects v3/v5/v6 with a caller-supplied buffer; web3.js calls uuid v4 with no buffer argument, so the bounds check is never reached.
